# Isaiah Chapter 21 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 17 verses]*

*Desert vision; Babylon's fall announced; Edom's enigmatic inquiry; Arabian oracle*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the carved images of her gods he has shattered. This chapter desert vision.

*-- LOGOS*
